音符基础滚速 / SV 倍率。: Base note scroll speed / SV multiplier.
作用：控制音符纵向滚动的基础倍率。: Controls the base multiplier for vertical note scrolling.
默认：{0}；最终纵向倍率还会乘 velocity 与逐轨 scrollindN: Default: {0}; the final vertical rate also multiplies velocity and per-lane scrollindN.
关系：scrollspeed × velocity × scrollindN 决: scrollspeed × velocity × scrollindN determines the main vertical speed.
用途：整段变速、SV 变化；负值可造成反向滚动，0 会使主要滚动停住。: Use for sustained speed / SV changes. Negative values reverse scrolling; 0 stops the main motion.
这是 GLOBAL mod；编辑器即使源 VSM 没有事件也会保留空轨供新增。: A GLOBAL mod. The editor keeps an empty track available even when the source VSM has no events.
作用：在 scrollspeed 之外再乘一次全局速度倍率。: Multiplies global speed in addition to scrollspeed.
用途：更适合做临时加速、减速或瞬时 SV，而不改工程基础 ScrollSpeed: Useful for temporary acceleration, deceleration or instant SV without changing the project's base ScrollSpeed.
它改变音符运动速度，不改变音乐播放速度。: Changes note movement speed, not music playback speed.
普通 Note / Bumper 贴图旋转角度。: Texture rotation for ordinary notes / bumpers.
作用：传给普通 Note 与 Bumper 的贴图旋转，单位为度。: Sets ordinary note and bumper texture rotation in degrees.
默认：{0}°；90 / 180 / 360 都可直接作为目标值。: Default: {0}°; targets such as 90 / 180 / 360 can be used directly.
注意：Hold 使用独立长条几何绘制，不按普通 Note 的同一路径旋转。: Holds use separate strip geometry and do not rotate through the ordinary note rendering path.
如果想旋转整个轨道 / 判定区，应使用 proxy 的 prrz，而不是 not: To rotate the entire lane / judgement area, use the proxy's prrz instead of noterot.
这是 GLOBAL mod，对当前画面中的普通 Note 生效。: A GLOBAL mod affecting ordinary notes in the current frame.
音符纵向波浪位移幅度。: Amplitude of vertical note wave displacement.
作用：按 Note 到判定线的距离加入正弦纵向偏移。: Adds sinusoidal vertical displacement based on note distance from the judgement line.
当前预览公式按 distance 计算，因此拖时间轴与正常播放共用同一求值。: The preview uses distance, so scrubbing and normal playback share the same evaluation.
它不是音乐波形，也不是时间轴上的 AUDIO / PEAKS。: This is unrelated to the music waveform or AUDIO / PEAKS in the timeline.
与 scrollspeed / velocity 可以同时叠加。: Can be combined with scrollspeed / velocity.
作用：控制普通 Note / Hold / Bumper 的基础透明度。: Controls base opacity for ordinary notes / holds / bumpers.
默认：{0}；通常 0 = 隐藏，1 = 原透明度。: Default: {0}; usually 0 hides notes and 1 preserves their original opacity.
Custom Gimmicks 还可再乘 notealpindN 形成逐轨透明度: Custom Gimmicks can also multiply notealpindN for per-lane opacity.
它不等于 uialpha；后者控制玩法 HUD。: Different from uialpha, which controls the gameplay HUD.
适合做 Note 淡入、淡出或短暂隐藏。: Use for note fade-ins, fade-outs or temporary hiding.
所有 Note 的额外横向位移。: Additional horizontal displacement for all notes.
作用：给 NoteMotion.X 增加全局 X 偏移。: Adds a global X offset to NoteMotion.X.
默认：{0}；单位使用游戏逻辑坐标。: Default: {0}; units are game logical coordinates.
逐轨版本是 xoffsetindN，可与 beat 横摆同时叠加。: The per-lane version is xoffsetindN; it combines with the beat sway effect.
只移动 Note 运动结果；并不等价于 proxy prx 的整轨移动。: Only moves the resulting note positions, unlike prx which moves the entire proxy.
需要整个轨道、判定区一起移动时优先用 proxy。: Use a proxy to move the whole lane and judgement area together.
所有 Note 的纵向距离偏移。: Vertical distance offset for all notes.
作用：修改 Note 到判定线的纵向距离项。: Changes the vertical distance term between notes and the judgement line.
默认：{0}；逐轨版本为 yoffsetindN。: Default: {0}; the per-lane version is yoffsetindN.
它会参与 scrollspeed / velocity 后的纵向位置计算。: Participates in the vertical position calculation with scrollspeed / velocity.
因此相同 yoffset 在不同 SV 下的画面位移可能不同。: The same yoffset may therefore produce different visual displacement at different SV values.
适合做 Note 位置偏移，不等价于整个 proxy 的 pry。: Use for note position offsets; it is not equivalent to moving the whole proxy with pry.
作用：根据当前 beat 和 Note 距离产生左右摆动。: Produces horizontal sway based on the current beat and note distance.
这是 NoteMotion 的一部分，不会移动固定 HUD。: Part of NoteMotion; it does not move the fixed HUD.
适合做随节拍左右扭动的 Note gimmick。: Use for notes that sway from side to side with the beat.
Note boost 的纵向位移强度。: Vertical displacement strength for note boost.
作用：与 boost_time 组合，改变接近判定线时的纵向运动曲线。: Works with boost_time to change the vertical motion curve near the judgement line.
默认：{0}；0 时全局 boost 分支关闭。: Default: {0}; 0 disables the global boost branch.
Custom Gimmicks 可再叠加 boost_distanceindN。: Custom Gimmicks can additionally apply boost_distanceindN.
这不是简单恒定速度倍率，而是距离相关的三次曲线偏移。: A distance-dependent cubic offset, rather than a constant speed multiplier.
需要纯 SV 时优先使用 scrollspeed / velocity。: Use scrollspeed / velocity for pure SV changes.
Note boost 曲线的作用距离 / 时间参数。: Distance / time parameter of the note boost curve.
作用：与 boost_distance 共同决定 boost 曲线。: Defines the boost curve together with boost_distance.
默认：{0}；当前实现按 Note 的 distance 值参与计算。: Default: {0}; the current implementation evaluates it using note distance.
boost_distance 为 0 时这一组 boost 不产生全局位移。: When boost_distance is 0, this boost group produces no global displacement.
不要把它当作事件 Duration；它是 gimmick 自身参数。: This is a gimmick parameter, not the event Duration.
作用：控制固定玩法 UI / 底部区域的可见度。: Controls visibility of the fixed gameplay UI / bottom area.
默认：{0}；0 通常隐藏，1 通常显示。: Default: {0}; usually 0 hides it and 1 shows it.
它不是 notealp，也不是图片 imgalp。: Different from notealp and image imgalp.
特殊原生对象自己绘制的 UI 不一定受这一项自动控制。: UI drawn by special native objects may not automatically follow this value.
用于隐藏 / 淡入玩法 HUD，而不是改变 Note。: Use to hide / fade the gameplay HUD, rather than notes.
轨道 Proxy 横向位置。: Horizontal position of the lane proxy.
与 prxb / prxc / prxd 相加后成为最终横向位移。: Adds prxb / prxc / prxd to produce the final horizontal displacement.
轨道 Proxy 纵向位置。: Vertical position of the lane proxy.
与 pryb / pryc / pryd 相加后成为最终纵向位移。: Adds pryb / pryc / pryd to produce the final vertical displacement.
轨道 Proxy 的 2D 旋转角。: 2D rotation angle of the lane proxy.
与 prrzb 相加并乘 rotdir；单位为度。: Adds prrzb and multiplies rotdir; units are degrees.
轨道 Proxy 的统一缩放倍率。: Uniform scale of the lane proxy.
会再乘 przmb / przmc / przx / przy 等缩放项。: Also multiplies scale terms such as przmb / przmc / przx / przy.
0 时该 proxy 不绘制；1 为正常不额外衰减。: At 0 the proxy is not drawn; 1 applies no additional attenuation.
作用：只对对应 lane 的 Note 纵向滚动再乘一个倍率。: Applies an additional vertical scroll multiplier only to notes on the corresponding lane.
默认：{0}；最终关系仍是 scrollspeed × velocity × s: Default: {0}; the combined rate is still scrollspeed × velocity × scrollindN.
N 是源 mod 名中的轨道索引；原始名字会在左侧保持不变。: N is the lane index in the source mod name. The original name remains unchanged on the left.
适合单轨加速 / 减速 / 反向，而不是整个 proxy 变换。: Use for per-lane acceleration, deceleration or reverse scrolling, rather than a whole-proxy transform.
具体 lane 绑定遵循目标 Custom Gimmicks 协议。: Lane bindings follow the target Custom Gimmicks protocol.
作用：与 notealp 相乘，只影响对应 lane。: Multiplies notealp and affects only the corresponding lane.
可用于单轨淡入、淡出或隐藏。: Use to fade in, fade out or hide one lane.
原始 N 索引按目标 Custom Gimmicks 协议解释。: The original N index follows the target Custom Gimmicks protocol.
轨道左侧保持 source identifier，不改成人造别名。: The source identifier remains on the left, without a UI alias.
作用：{0}，目标是当前 Pn proxy，而不是单个 Note。: Effect: {0}; targets the current Pn proxy, not an individual note.
Proxy 变换会连同该轨道副本中的判定区 / Note 一起合成。: Proxy transforms composite the judgement area and notes in that lane copy together.
左侧的 Pn 小标只表示目标；轨道主名称仍保持原始 mod identifier: The Pn badge on the left identifies the target; the main track name remains the original mod identifier.
控制图片中心的游戏逻辑 X 坐标。: Sets the image center's X position in game logical coordinates.
控制图片中心的游戏逻辑 Y 坐标。: Sets the image center's Y position in game logical coordinates.
0 隐藏，1 为正常透明度；最终仍受该图层绘制规则影响。: 0 hides the image; 1 preserves normal opacity. Layer rendering rules still apply.
值会四舍五入并按该图片的帧数取模。: The value is rounded and wrapped by the image frame count.
写入图片变换矩阵的横向斜切项。: Sets the horizontal skew term of the image transform matrix.
写入图片变换矩阵的纵向斜切项。: Sets the vertical skew term of the image transform matrix.
按 NoteMotion 计算图片 X 时间偏移。: Image X time offset evaluated through NoteMotion.
把该值作为 distance 送入 NoteMotion.X，再叠加到图片 X。: Passes this value to NoteMotion.X as distance, then adds the result to image X.
按 NoteMotion 计算图片 Y 时间偏移。: Image Y time offset evaluated through NoteMotion.
把该值作为 distance 送入 NoteMotion.Y，再叠加到图片 Y。: Passes this value to NoteMotion.Y as distance, then adds the result to image Y.
按 NoteMotion 计算图片纵向时间缩放。: Image vertical time scaling evaluated through NoteMotion.
遵循目标 v1.12.7 的原始公式计算纵向尺度。: Calculates vertical scale using the original formula from target v1.12.7.
该参数属于 VSP 图片实例的普通 VSM 控制轨。: An ordinary VSM control track for a VSP image instance.
对象：{0}；原始轨道名保持 {1}_{2}。: Object: {0}; the original track name remains {1}_{2}.
这条轨道控制已声明的 VSP 图片对象，不会创建新的图片资源。: This track controls a declared VSP image object; it does not create a new image resource.
需要更换素材 / 图层时应修改资源或对象声明，而不是改这个数值轨。: To replace an asset or change its layer, edit the resource or object declaration rather than this numeric track.
对象：{0}；轨道名直接来自源 VSM。: Object: {0}; the track name comes directly from the source VSM.
文字内容本身来自对应 text 文件；这条轨道只控制其显示属性。: Text content comes from the corresponding text file. This track controls only its display properties.
删除数值事件不会删除文字文件或文字 cue。: Deleting numeric events does not delete the text file or its cues.
未知 / 未声明目标会继续由兼容报告说明，而不是偷偷改绑其他文字。: Unknown / undeclared targets are reported as compatibility notices, without silently rebinding them.
源 VSM mod；语义未内置说明。: Source VSM mod with no built-in semantic explanation.
原始 identifier：{0}；默认值（当前目录规则）：{1}。: Original identifier: {0}; default under the current catalog rules: {1}.
预览器已把它列为支持项；具体视觉效果仍取决于当前对象 / 资源 / 房间。: Listed as supported by the previewer; the visual result still depends on the current object, resources and room.
编辑器会保留并允许编辑结构化事件，但不会凭空编造未知语义。: The editor preserves structured events and allows editing without inventing unknown behavior.
片段字段仍是 Beat / Duration / From / To / Eas: Clip fields remain Beat / Duration / From / To / Ease / Proxy.
左侧永远显示原始名字；这个帮助层不会改写保存到 VSM 的 identifier: The original name is always shown on the left; help never rewrites identifiers saved to VSM.
若它来自特殊原生 gimmick，兼容报告可能给出比这里更具体的限制。: For special native gimmicks, the compatibility report may list more specific limitations.
目标：WINDOW {0}；通过 preset 与运动参数驱动窗口位置 / 角度: Target: WINDOW {0}; preset and motion parameters drive window position / angle.
时间轴显示 Beat，但配置文件中的 t / easeDur 仍以秒保存。: The timeline shows beats, but t / easeDur in the config file are still saved in seconds.
Move / Sway / Wrap / Ellipse / ShakePer: Presets such as Move / Sway / Wrap / Ellipse / ShakePer use the same event type.
DESKTOP 是虚拟桌面预览；LIVE 才会创建 / 移动真实 SDL 窗口。: DESKTOP is a virtual preview; LIVE creates / moves real SDL windows.
拖片段主体改开始时间，拖右端手柄改 easeDur。: Drag the clip body to change its start time; drag the right handle to change easeDur.
目标：WINDOW {0}；控制 sx / sy、pivot 与 anchor。: Target: WINDOW {0}; controls sx / sy, pivot and anchor.
时间轴显示 Beat；源 JSON 的 t / dur 使用秒。: The timeline shows beats; source JSON t / dur use seconds.
拖右侧手柄会修改 dur，而不是改音乐速度。: Dragging the right handle changes dur, not music speed.
窗口内容来源与窗口几何是两套独立状态。: Window content sources and window geometry are independent states.
真实窗口效果只在 LIVE 模式下作用到桌面。: Real window effects apply to the desktop only in LIVE mode.
目标：WINDOW {0}；show 决定事件之后的可见状态。: Target: WINDOW {0}; show determines visibility after the event.
这是瞬时状态事件，没有可拉伸的持续区间。: An instantaneous state event with no stretchable duration.
隐藏窗口不会自动删除它的内容绑定或后续事件。: Hiding a window does not delete its content bindings or later events.
虚拟桌面和 LIVE 后端都使用同一份窗口状态求值。: The virtual desktop and LIVE backend share the same window-state evaluation.
时间轴上的位置由源 JSON 秒值换算为 Beat 显示。: Source JSON times in seconds are converted to beats for the timeline.
